html:
Experience the Mekong Delta with Vietlook Travel immerse yourself in rivers, culture, and Southern Vietnamese cuisine on this 3 day journey from My Tho to Ca Mau, guided by experienced professionals.

Saigon – My Tho – Ben Tre – Can Tho – Ca Mau

Duration: 3 days 2 nights

Departure time: 7:10 AM (Day 1)

Return time: 19:00 PM (Day 3)

Transportation: Air-conditioned bus

Price/pax: 135$

DAY 1 – SAIGON – MY THO – BEN TRE – CAN THO

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Pick-up at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market (6:50 – 7:20 AM). Depart for My Tho and Ben Tre.

  • Mekong Restop: Enjoy typical Southern Vietnamese breakfast (Hu Tieu My Tho, Com Tam), restrooms available, and optional snacks.

  • Vinh Trang Pagoda: 19th-century architectural relic combining European and Asian styles.

  • My Tho River Cruise: Boat trip along Tien River, visit four islets (Long, Lan, Qui, Phung), floating fish rafts, and Rach Mieu Bridge.

  • Thoi Son Island (Lan Island): Walk through village roads, local houses, fruit gardens; visit honey bee farm, enjoy honey lemon tea.

  • Cultural Experience: Southern folk music (Don Ca Tai Tu Xu Dua), fruit tasting, rowing through canals, visit coconut candy workshop.

Noon: Lunch at a local restaurant. Optional activities: fishing for crocodiles, walking on the monkey bridge, resting in hammocks, cycling along village roads.

Afternoon (2:30 PM): Return to My Tho by boat, then depart for Can Tho (2–3 hours drive). Check-in at city center hotel.

Evening (6:30 PM): Dinner on a luxury yacht at Ninh Kieu Wharf with Western cuisine and Southern folk music.

9:30 PM: Yacht docks. Free time to explore Can Tho city nightlife. Return to hotel.

DAY 2 – CAN THO – CAI RANG FLOATING MARKET – CA MAU

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch – Dinner

Morning: Breakfast at hotel. Visit:

  • Cai Rang Floating Market: One of the largest floating markets in the Mekong Delta. See local trade and Hu Tieu craft village.

  • Soc Trang: SomRong Temple – largest reclining Buddha temple in Vietnam with Khmer architecture.

  • Bac Lieu: Tac Say Church – Gia Rai Bac Lieu, grave of Father Truong Buu Diep.

Noon: Depart for Ca Mau. Lunch at Anh Nguyet Restaurant.

Afternoon: Explore Ca Mau Cape:

  • Mangrove forest, National Coordinate Landmark – GPS 0001, panoramic view of Ca Mau Cape

  • Visit the museum, Au Co’s mother statue, flagpole, and take souvenir photos

  • Return to hotel to rest

Evening (6:00 PM): Dinner and free time to explore Ca Mau city nightlife.

DAY 3 – CA MAU – BAC LIEU – SAI GON

Meals: Breakfast – Lunch

Morning: Breakfast at hotel and check-out. Depart for Bac Lieu:

  • Cong Tu Bac Lieu House: Built in 1919 by a French engineer with imported materials.

  • Nam Hai Buddha: Pray for good luck for yourself and family.

  • Soc Trang: Visit Quang Tran Pia Cake Factory (since 1950).

Noon: Lunch in Hau Giang with Southern specialties (Hotpot, garden chicken, Linh fish, fried cod fish).

Afternoon: Return journey to Ho Chi Minh City. Rest stop at Cai Be station.

Evening (7:00 PM): Arrive in Ho Chi Minh City. End of tour.

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Pick-up and drop-off at centrally located hotels near Ben Thanh Market

  • Entrance fees

  • Meals: 3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 2 dinners

  • 2-night hotel stay in city center or equivalent (2–3 people per room)

  • Air-conditioned bus and mineral water

  • Sightseeing tickets, boat trips, rowing boat, bicycle

  • Traditional music, fruits, honey tea

  • Travel insurance

  • Entry/admission – Vinh Trang Pagoda

  • Experienced English-speaking guide

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Single-room surcharge: 600,000 VND for 2-night 3-star hotel

  • Personal expenses or items not included in tour inclusions

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children 5 to under 10 years old: 75% of ticket price, with seats on the bus, same standard of meals as adults

  • Children 4 years old and under: free of charge, sit on parents’ lap (two adults may accompany one free child). From the second child onward, 75% of ticket price applies

  • Children 10 years old and above: full adult ticket required
